concept: Living Open-World Crypto Launchpad (Ingress x GitCity Inspiration)

context_strategy.primary_mode: Top-down 3D explorable crypto city map where every launched token is a building and market cap dictates building height.
context_strategy.emotional_tone: Tactical Cyberpunk Command, Financial Sovereignty, Living Market Ecosystem
context_strategy.no_demo_policy: STRICT REQUIREMENT: Absolutely no 'demo', 'simulate', 'mock', or 'testnet placeholder' labels in the visual interface. All UI components must read like a polished, live production app on Solana.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight font-display uppercase
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight font-display

layout_and_structure.viewport_hero: FULL-SCREEN 3D CITY CANVAS (`/` opens directly into 3D world map)
layout_and_structure.hud_overlay_strategy: Fixed glassmorphism top header (`z-40`), right/left tactical collapsible panels (`z-30`), and floating mini-map controls (`z-30`)
layout_and_structure.bento_grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Tactical Dashboard for Token Info & Trading

3d_city_engine_spec.tech_stack: HTML5 Canvas 2.5D / Three.js / React Three Fiber / WebGL fallback
3d_city_engine_spec.camera: Top-down Orthographic/Perspective view with zoom (Scroll/Pinch) and pan (Drag)

building_visuals.$100K-$1M: Low-rise tactical block (12px - 40px height), soft pulse, cyan accent window lights
building_visuals.$1M-$10M: Mid-rise corporate tower (40px - 110px height), neon logo billboard top, purple edge glow
building_visuals.$10M-$100M+: Dominant Megastructure Skyscraper (110px - 280px height), glowing holographic emitter spire, animated pulse light strips

3d_city_engine_spec.territories: Ingress-like polygonal territory bounds with glowing animated boundary lines and team crest banners
3d_city_engine_spec.click_interaction: Clicking a building smoothly zooms camera to building roof and opens the Token Dashboard view with full trade modal

key_features_and_flows.full_screen_3d_city: Interactive city grid showing all launched tokens as living 3D structures. Allows filtering by district, market cap, volume, and new launches.
key_features_and_flows.token_dashboard: Triggered on building click. Features TradingView-style price chart, Solana Buy/Sell swap widget, holder list, market stats, live activity feed, and bounties.
key_features_and_flows.creator_custom_bounties: Token creators issue custom bounties (e.g. 'Meme Campaign', 'Volume Milestone', 'Content Quest') tied to their city territory with SOL / Token rewards.
key_features_and_flows.token_launchpad_wizard: Form modal within the city allowing creators to enter Token Name, Ticker, Symbol Image, Initial Supply, and District Location to spawn a brand new building in real-time.
key_features_and_flows.solana_wallet_integration: Interactive wallet connect button (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack) showing real wallet balances, SOL trading capability, and transaction notifications via Sonner.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle Cyber Grid overlay, noise grain, holographic sweep animations, scanlines for HUD metrics
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or chamfered cyber buttons with neon hover rings and active press animations
visual_enhancers.toasts: Sonner toasts with green/cyan cyber theme (`bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 border-cyan-500/40`)

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, map controls, building triggers, trade forms) MUST include distinct data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='solana-wallet-connect-btn', data-testid='token-building-bonk', data-testid='buy-token-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA readable high-contrast text overlay over dark city map visuals

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Render the main page directly as an explorable 3D / 2.5D top-down city canvas with zoom, pan, district territories, and click-to-view building interactions.
2. Ensure building heights dynamically recalculate according to market cap values.
3. On building selection, display the Token Dashboard modal/view with live charts, buy/sell swap, bounties, and holder analytics.
4. Implement real Solana wallet status with wallet selection popup (Phantom / Solflare), simulated live balances, and transaction execution flow without using any 'demo' or 'simulate' labels.
5. Enable creator token launching which immediately adds a new 3D building into the city grid in the chosen district.
6. Apply data-testid to every interactive component across the app.
